title: Chapter 42 Tiger Territory
content:
Chapter 42 Tiger Territory

Wu Qing evaluated the combat capability of the Zerg. In terms of close combat, they are stronger than the puppies. After all, there is a huge gap in the resources consumed between the two, so it is natural that they are stronger.

In terms of long-range attacks, the Zerg can launch biological spikes through biological colonization, and its attack method is similar to that of the Hydralisk.

But the threat is much worse than that of the Hydralisk, and their long-range combat capability is completely incomparable to that of the Hydralisk.

The consumption of Zerg is much more than that of the Hydralisk, especially the gas resources, which are exactly half more, but on the battlefield where the two armies are fighting, the role of Zerg may not be better than that of a Hydralisk.

If there is no special need, the Zerg unit of Zerg has no need to exist at all.

Zerg is too cost-effective for the Zerg and has no value.

But for Wu Qing, he is still quite satisfied, and basically meets his requirements.

Wu Qing consumed 500 energy points and 500 gas points to hatch an enhanced Zerg that looks exactly like him.

This Zerg is different from other Zerg. Only he and the Queen can control it, and there will be no simulated false personality.

He wanted to use this special Zergman as a stand-in temporarily. His current strength improvement was tied to the development of the territory, and it was unrealistic to want to improve quickly.

With his strength of less than one star, it was still too risky to walk around in this weird and god-infested world, and it was not convenient to do many things when possessed by an ordinary Zerg.

Now that he had a Zergman, he could just use him as a stand-in, so that he could personally do many things.

If this mysterious lord wanted to show up, he still had to be well-mannered. He spent a lot of resources to make this Zergman stand-in, and ordinary people could not see its specific strength.

Hiding the real strength was an invisible deterrent.

He also asked the Queen of Zerg to hatch a Zerg unit in the shape of a dark and majestic warhorse according to the image of his original mount, Wuzhui, specifically for his stand-in to ride.

The Zergman stand-in rode on the horse, led ten human heavy infantry guards and numerous Zerg troops, and his temperament as a powerful lord came out.

Otherwise, if Wu Qing still follows the Zerg on the ground, other lords will look down on him from the bottom of their hearts, just like the little guy from the Tengu clan.

In this way, many things will be difficult to discuss.

It is still early now. Taking advantage of the aftermath of a war, Wu Qing is going to use a substitute to personally visit the largest territory in the surrounding area, a native race territory called Tiger Territory.

According to the intelligence reconnaissance by the puppy, this Tiger Territory is the territory of a tiger lord, with a population of more than 50,000. It is one of the most powerful territories in this area except for the main territory of the Tengu clan.

Other territories around that have not evacuated actively have some relationship with this Tiger Territory.

The tiger clan is powerful. It is said that the lord of the Tiger Territory has an elite force composed entirely of tiger clans under his command. This is the strength guarantee for them to grow and develop within the sphere of influence of the Tengu clan.

The influence of such a territory in the surrounding area can be imagined.

Instead of looking for other territories one by one, it is better to go directly to this Tiger Territory.

After the hatching of the stand-in and the mount, Wu Qing looked at the Zergman who looked exactly like him and felt a little uncomfortable. He returned to the mother nest and put his consciousness into the Zergman stand-in.

After getting familiar with the stand-in's body, he pulled the familiar-looking but actually unfamiliar mount, climbed on the horse, and trotted around.

After changing the biological colonization suit on the stand-in into a set of gorgeous armor, he rode on a warhorse and led ten Zergmen dressed as heavy infantrymen to set off.

The Zergmen looked like they were wearing heavy equipment, but in fact, this biological colonization suit did not affect their speed at all. They could quickly keep up with the trotting warhorses.

Soon after leaving the Zerg territory, Wu Qing joined the retreating Zerg army.

Wu Qing gathered 5,000 puppies, 400 hydralisks and 20 hosts to follow, and three one-star hydralisks came to his stand-in's side to protect him closely.

This army marched towards the Tiger Territory in a mighty manner.

On the way, he deliberately passed by other territories and traveled in a high-profile manner.

There were also several lords of the territories who specially sent people out of the city to invite Wu Qing to enter the city, but he politely declined.

Wu Qing led the Zerg army and finally arrived at the territory of the Tiger Territory after a long journey.

Standing on a high place and looking far away, there stood a large city made entirely of huge stones on the flat ground. The momentum of this city was more magnificent than the one that was broken by the bear goblins.

"Tiger Territory, dare to call it this name, this territory really has this confidence!"

Wu Qing could see a little bit of the courage of the Tiger Territory lord from this city, and he had some expectations for this tiger lord.

The Zerg army he led had long been discovered by the Tiger Territory scouts, but these scouts did not know the destination of this army and had been on guard from a distance.

Wu Qing led the Zerg army and deliberately drove straight into the city of the Tiger Territory.

The Zerg army had a good momentum, but they had no killing intent and did not deploy an attack formation, so the scouts in the distance did not overreact.

The people working and traveling outside the city were not panicked, but just stopped their work and stood by to watch.

These people were almost all powerful races such as the cattle, elephants, and leopards. There were no people from other weak races. From these details, it can be seen that this territory is indeed not simple.

Several scouts ran to the front of the Zerg army and fearlessly stopped the fast-moving Zerg army.

"Excuse me, the army ahead! Which lord's army is it?"

"What's the important matter in the Tiger Territory?"

The leading scout asked loudly.

He has a tiger head and a human body, is strong and powerful, riding a tiger, holding a tiger-headed broadsword, and his height should be more than two meters and five.

This is an elite cavalryman of the Tiger Tribe. He personally led the troops as a scout, which shows how tense the situation is recently.

A bug man stood out from the crowd and responded loudly: "This is the army led by the Lord of Daxia Territory!"

"Our Lord has important matters and needs to visit the Lord of your territory in person. Please inform him!"

Knowing that the human knight riding a tall horse in front of the battle is the Lord of Daxia Territory, the Tiger Tribe cavalryman immediately got off the tiger mount, held his chest and saluted, saying: "I didn't know that the Lord was in person, please forgive me!"

The people in this world have an instinctive respect for the lord, especially for the powerful lord.

Wu Qing's strength was worthy of respect from the elite tiger cavalry.

Wu Qing rode forward a few steps and said, "Ignorance is not a crime! This brave knight, please don't be polite!"

"Thank you, Lord, for your kindness!"

"Please enter the city, Lord!"

The tiger knight led the tiger and led the way in front. Other scouts had already reported the latest intelligence to the city.

The Zerg army slowed down its march. The two sides had already come into contact. Wu Qing had to give the lord of the tiger territory some time to prepare.
